nodes.label: Barra de grifos (tap bar photo)
nodes.description: Photo of a craft beer taproom bar: a long wooden counter with a row of about 30 stainless-steel beer taps on a copper/steel backsplash. Above the taps are blank chalkboard menu panels; glassware and bottle shelves flank them. Copper pendant lamps and Edison bulbs hang over the bar, with exposed brick walls, black steel beams, a concrete floor and 12 wooden-and-black-metal stools. It is likely a hero or showcase image for the landing page.
